questions_and_answers.question_text: What does zǒngde lái shuō mean?
What is the similar phrase using ...lái shuō?
What is the NEW use of ba shown here?
What part of speech is biànhuà, and only that?
What does zhōngxīn mean before a noun?
Write the Chinese for "On the whole, you did a good job."

answers.answer_text: Zǒngde lái shuō, nǐmende gōngzuò gǎode bú cuò.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Běijīng is the political and cultural center of China."

answers.answer_text: Běijīng shi Zhōngguóde zhèngzhì, wénhuà zhōngxīn.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Generally speaking, Chinese people are always polite."

answers.answer_text: Yìbān lái shuō, Zhōngguó rén zǒngshi hěn kèqi.
The official city level of government — e.g., Běijīng shì, "Běijīng municipality."

articles.text:
9. A: Zǒngde lái shuō ba, zhèige     Generally speaking, the changes in this
      chéngshìde biànhuà shi hěn     city have been great.
      dàde.
   B: Shì a, zhàn zài shì zhōngxīnde Yes, standing on top of the building in
      dàlóushang kànkan, wǒ dōu bú   the center of the city, looking out, I
      rènshi le!                     don't recognize anything anymore!

Notes on No. 9

zǒngde lái shuō: "generally speaking," "on the whole"

Zǒngde lái shuō, wǒmen xuéxiào   Generally speaking, our school's students
xuéshēngde shuǐpíng dōu shi hěn  are of a very high caliber.
gāode.
Zǒngde lái shuō, nǐmende gōngzuò On the whole, you did a good job.
gǎode bú cuò.

A SIMILAR phrase using the pattern ...LÁI SHUŌ is YÌBĀN LÁI SHUŌ, "generally speaking," "ordinarily":

Yìbān lái shuō, wǒ měige yuè qù  Generally speaking I go see him once a
kàn ta yícì.                     month.
Yìbān lái shuō, Zhōngguó rén     Generally speaking, Chinese people are
zǒngshi hěn kèqi.                always polite.

ba: This is a NEW USE of ba for you. It is used in COLLOQUIAL SPEECH to MARK A PAUSE in the sentence, SETTING OFF THE TOPIC which precedes it (in this case, zǒngde lái shuō).

Zhèige rén ba, bú shi zuò        This guy — he isn't foreign service
wàijiāoguānde cáiliào.           officer material.

biànhuà: "change(s)." This is ONLY used as a NOUN.

Shínián bú jiàn, tā biànhuà hǎo  He hadn't seen her in ten years, and she
dà.                              had changed a great deal.

shì: "city," "municipality." Used mostly in reference to the OFFICIAL CITY LEVEL of government, e.g., Dàqìng shì, "the city of Dàqìng"; Běijīng shì, "Běijīng municipality"; shì bànde, "city-run." Shì is also used in a few set phrases like SHÌ ZHŌNGXĪN, "center of the city," "downtown."

zhōngxīn: "center," "heart," "core," "hub"

Běijīng shi Zhōngguóde zhèngzhì, Běijīng is the political and cultural
wénhuà zhōngxīn.                 center of China.
Wǒmen hái méiyou tándào wèntíde  We haven't yet touched on the core of
zhōngxīn.                        the question.

Zhōngxīn can also be used BEFORE a noun to modify it. It then translates as "CENTRAL":

Zhèixiē niánde zhōngxīn gōngzuò  The central task now and in the coming
shi gǎo jīngjì jiànshè.          years is to engage in economic
                                 construction.
